scope: W01-W07 bounded Windows control lifecycle repair; software-only evidence

Breakaway or other required-flag startup failure has one fail-closed attempt and an actionable external-daemon command.
Dispatch keeps EXECUTION_STATE_UNKNOWN while returning the specialized type, action, and diagnostic message.

Production model/result directories pass canonical_project_path and reject .phase1-private, .phase2-private, and control-private.
After stdio teardown, the same control PID and Worker identity are read back before authenticated release.
Owned control cleanup requires Worker disconnected, queued_or_running=0, active_jobs=[], and verified ownership; it sends no force-kill fallback.
